question: What claim is being made here about the total classes of yoginīs with respect to their origin and function?
premises: All innate yoginīs are in question.
All family-born yoginīs are in question.
All door-guarding yoginīs are in question.
inference: All innate, all family-born, and all door-guarding yoginīs are included in this class.
uncertainties: The unity of these classes is not explained in this verse.
plain_english: All innate, all family-born, and all door-guardians are here.
